level_id_bank.verdict: Positional. Archetype: post-vertical drawdown at a trendline apex, oversold. The name ran a vertical 2023-24 leg and has given back roughly 38% from the Nov-2025 high. The structural map is three stacked monthly ladders in which the OLDER two -- dashed and dotted -- are the operator's preferred read. Immediately overhead is a 2.9-point cross-ladder reclaim gate at 706.60-709.50, led by the dashed 709.50; immediately below, a cross-ladder floor at 669.45-676.40. Above the gate the work is an eight-source MA/BMSB/fib shelf at 740.20-788.45, then the weekly cloud at 809.04-836.80. The structural invalidation is the violet demand band's floor at 613.00, which is the older ladder's anchor high; its ceiling at 642.25 is the newer ladder's.
level_id_bank.method: Fib (universal level set) -- THREE stacked monthly ladders, each verified rung-by-rung (Ladder 2 to eight rungs exact) + operator violet demand band + the descending trendline off the Nov-2025 high converging with two rising support lines + daily MA stack. Ladder attribution resolved by computation: the 3.618 = 1,223.1 rung belongs to Ladder 2, not Ladder 1 (whose own 3.618 computes to 1,261.4 and is not drawn).
